validity.researcher_notes:
Sheet's own citations returned empty for this row (wiki_citations.json harvest failed this run per scope note — Cloudflare 403 on gem.wiki for every automated fetch, including mine when I tried the row's own wiki URL). So this is ground-up open-web research, not a re-verification of existing sheet sources.

Found 3 independent non-GEM sources that explicitly name this pipeline:
(1) DAWN.COM, 'Commercial supply of gas from Gurguri field begins' (20 Feb 2005) — verified 200 OK, contains '78' and 'Gurguri'. States gas from the Gurguri oil/gas fields (Karak district) reaches Kohat and other parts via a '78 kilometre-long 10 inch-diameter pipeline' — an EXACT match to GEM's LengthKnown=78.00 km / Diameter=10 in, and the Feb-2005 commissioning date is consistent with Status=operating.
(2) DAWN.COM, 'Kohat: Pipeline row affects gas supply project' (2007) — verified 200 OK, contains 'Gurguri'. Independently names Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited (SNGPL) as the party that 'constructs and operates the pipeline' from the Gurguri field to northern NWFP/Kohat/Karak/Hangu — matches GEM's Owner1=SNGPL 100%. Separately identifies MOL + OGDCL as the FIELD operators (distinct from the pipeline owner, so no conflict). Confirms route detail (passes near Lachi town, ~22 km west of Kohat) and describes a later extension phase (construction started 2006, halted mid-2007 over local opposition, targeted for 2008) that is additional to — not a contradiction of — the 2005 core Gurguri-Kohat line.
(3) urdupoint.com (Urdu-language, 3 Jun 2019) — verified 200 OK, contains 'گُرگری' (Gurguri) and 'بحالی' (restoration). Headline: 'Kharpa Manjiwal, Gurguri-Kohat gas pipelines' restoration/repair work to start' — independently, in a different language/outlet/era, names this exact pipeline as still an in-service asset 14 years after commissioning (repair work implies an operating line, not a defunct one).
A 4th DAWN.COM article ('Kohat: work on gas pipeline in Karak starts', 2006, verified 200 OK) also surfaced but describes a related/parallel scheme carrying gas from 'Gurguri, Makori and other gas fields' onward to Dera Ismail Khan and 55 villages — a different destination from Kohat, so I did NOT cite it for this PID to avoid conflating what may be a separate distribution project fanning out from the same field cluster; flagging the ambiguity rather than resolving it here. An energynewsbulletin.net headline ('Sui Northern to build Gurguri-Kohat pipeline') looked like strong extra owner corroboration but the page 403'd with no Wayback capture available, so it is left unverified and uncited.

Existence (priority 1): HIGH. Three independent outlets (2005/2007/2019), none tracing to GEM or to each other, confirm a real, physically built and operated ~78 km / 10 in line from the Gurguri field (Karak district) to Kohat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Classification (priority 2): no concern. Owned/operated by SNGPL, a transmission/distribution utility (not the field operator) — consistent with ~50 similarly-shaped field-to-grid transmission spurs already in this same Pakistan-gas roster (e.g. P4074 Kandhkot, P4075 Pir Koh-Sui, P4090 Sui-Multan).
Duplicate (priority 3): checked the full 63-row roster — no other row starts at Gurguri or represents this Gurguri->Kohat corridor. P4176 (Kohat-Nowshera) starts AT Kohat and runs onward, a downstream continuation, not this line; P4181/P5486 (Sakhakot-Swat/Mardan-Swat) are a different corridor entirely. No duplicate found.
Attribution (priority 4): Owner1=SNGPL confirmed by source (2) above — one explicit independent source, so tier=medium on this axis specifically.
Spec (priority 5): Length=78.00 km and Diameter=10 in are corroborated by exactly ONE explicit numeric source (source 1) — I could not find a second independent source stating the same numbers despite EN + Urdu searching. Per the project's 2-independent-source rule this keeps Length/Diameter at tier=medium (one excellent, exact-matching contemporaneous primary-press source) rather than high, despite the precision of the match — recorded honestly rather than silently upgraded.
Endpoints/location: StartLocation=Gurguri/Karak and EndLocation=Kohat both match sources (1) and (2) exactly — high confidence on this axis.
Capacity remains genuinely blank in GEM; no reliable throughput/capacity figure surfaced in any source, so it is left unfilled per instructions (no fabrication) rather than staged as a fill.

summary: P4182 Gurguri-Kohat Gas Pipeline: existence/owner/endpoints/status confirmed by 3 independent EN+UR sources (Dawn 2005/2007, urdupoint 2019), no duplicate/classification issue found; verdict confirmed (caveat) because Length=78km/Diameter=10in and Owner=SNGPL each rest on only one explicit source (tier=medium) despite exact matches. Capacity left UNRESOLVED (genuinely blank, no reliable figure found, not fabricated).
